task: Consolidate providers onto Cloudflare (owner-approved 2026-11-24): Vercel -> Cloudflare Worker for retail-pilot-intel docs; Resend -> Cloudflare Email Service in private apps/grants; owner closing steps
errors: Local sweep: new docs/reports file lacked `kind` front matter (doc_index), and `wrangler dev` left apps/docs/.wrangler/ which retail-pilot-intel's eslint linted. Fixed: front matter added; .wrangler/ gitignored and eslint-ignored.

doc_friction.issue: run_workflow_locally refuses to sweep while the run record's outcome is null, but the record is meant to be filled after the PR exists; --no-record-check is the way through and could be named in the message.

deviations.why: Owner brief asked to move the Vercel deploy 'keeping its URL working or redirected'. The Vercel job never ran (VERCEL_DEPLOY unset; runs 45374351301 and earlier show it skipped), so there was no URL to keep; the new Cloudflare job is opt-in (manual run or RETAIL_PILOT_INTEL_DOCS_CLOUDFLARE=true) like the job it replaces, so nothing new publishes without the owner.
deviations.did: Separate free-plan Worker, not a directory of marisstella.app (both site Workers near the 20k-file limit).
deviations.result: Config verified by wrangler dry-run and wrangler dev; live verification is the owner's first manual run.

deviations.why: Brief step 1 said 'if it holds up' move Resend. Cloudflare Email Service holds up for transactional mail but its FAQ forbids marketing mail, so the newsletter sequence stays on Resend; Resend can only be closed if that sequence stays off.
deviations.did: Category-routed sender with EMAIL_PROVIDER auto|cloudflare|resend in the private repo (PR private-monorepo#10).
deviations.result: 1565 grants tests pass locally; owner switches with EMAIL_PROVIDER=cloudflare after onboarding the domain.

notes: Local verification (oss): wrangler@4.145.0 deploy --dry-run on apps/docs passes; wrangler dev serves / 200 with x-robots-tag noindex and x-frame-options DENY, unknown path 404, /_headers 404. run_workflow_locally --for-changes: all failures traced to the report front matter, the .wrangler/ dir and this record; after fixes re-run (see PR). Private repo: pnpm typecheck clean; test:unit+test:worker 142 files / 1565 tests pass; biome clean; e2e 04-draft-submit fails identically on main 8c3a592 (pre-existing, approve button disabled). Control-plane workflow change is separate PR oss-monorepo#18670 (needs owner approval).
